criteria.reason: The keyboard row contains Copy Last, Done, and Next buttons.
Done uses flex sizing in the three-button row instead of full width.
All action buttons have a 48px minimum height.
Copy Last reads the preceding set’s value for the active field and puts it in the keypad state.
Next changes the active field to reps and updates the value and label.
The buttons use design tokens for borders, colors, and radius, but Done still uses a hard-coded white text color.
The compact flex row gives the three buttons room to fit the existing keypad layout on mobile.
The button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all 197 server and 291 client tests passing.
The new test checks that Copy Last invokes a supplied handler, but does not test copying the previous set’s value.
